how: Hand-picked public X posts that explain how to get more out of a specific Howff bot. Excerpts are the post text with links removed; every card links to the original post.

tips.author: waynesutton
tips.title: Type "scan" in the morning
tips.excerpt: Bot inbox: type "scan". One line per unread bot or group chat. I use it in the morning so I do not have to open 40 chats. It does not change other bots or mark anything as read.

tips.author: andymadrick
tips.title: Log every brew
tips.excerpt: fun little @bot i made: coffee companion ☕ i tell it what beans i have and it recommends a pour over recipe. after brewing, i chat with it to record tasting notes, drawdown time, what worked, what didn’t, etc.

tips.author: itsmechase
tips.title: Give it timestamps and a size
tips.excerpt: Manual video clipping is dead 💀 Just give @bot a YouTube link, tell it the time stamps you want to cut, choose the file dimensions, and BOOM you’ve got a 4k clipped video.

tips.author: realcoachmatt23
tips.title: Set a salary floor
tips.excerpt: …Then tell it the job titles you want, where, and your salary floor. It searches every day and sends you the best fits.

tips.author: allthemoney
tips.title: Talk to it like a person
tips.excerpt: It adds things to your calendar and reminds you ⏰. On the first chat it asks which calendar and time zone you use. 👉 Try: "Dentist Tuesday at 3, remind me an hour before" 🦷 Plans changed? Just say "move it to Thursday" 🔄

tips.author: teeRex247
tips.title: Snapshot the page first
tips.excerpt: Nice. The step before buying works great too: give @bot the product page and it saves a snapshot, then pings you only when the price drops or it's back in stock. Then you just tell it to order. Thanks @elonmusk.

tips.author: TimDOES
tips.title: Let everyone swap meals
tips.excerpt: Yup. Does it all for me. Creates the weeks meals, I can swap out the ones I don’t like, my wife can swap out what she doesn’t want, we tell it how many plates per night, creates the recipes, creates the shopping lists per store,…

tips.author: SuddenlyJon
tips.title: Photograph the fridge
tips.excerpt: Nourishment 🍱 Open fridge, take pic, snap one of pantry. Get real recipes, a grocery list on $x budget, new things to try based on what your taste.

tips.author: thecsguy
tips.title: Scan before you delete
tips.excerpt: if you want to try the disk doctor one, here's the template. it scans first, then asks before touching each group.

tips.author: TylerNishida
tips.title: Split life and work
tips.excerpt: i use grok bot by splitting tasks into two buckets: Life and Work. these bots will create new channels and specialist bots under them to complete tasks. if there is a task that counts as life and work, i default to life.

tips.author: MichaelGannotti
tips.title: One bot, one job
tips.excerpt: Shared First-Week Coach last week. The gist: Day 1: one bot, one job. Day 2: connect read-only. Day 3: schedule it. Day 7: keep, tune or retire.

tips.author: aryamankhawow
tips.title: Start with a chief of staff
tips.excerpt: First ship into @bot! If you haven't started using Grok Bot yet, would recommend starting with just one Chief of Staff bot. Use it to manage all the busy work in your life.

tips.author: _jsolly
tips.title: Let a VM do the watching
tips.excerpt: Link to @bot template: I pair it with a persistent VM in the cloud to reduce token use (think stuff like watching to see if a webpage changes). The VM ‘wakes’ the bot if something triggers. Could show my setup sometime if anyone is interested.

tips.author: matthewbarge
tips.title: Connect first, then forget it
tips.excerpt: Need to add receipts to your Ramp transactions? I'm sharing a Grok Bot that'll grab receipts from your Gmail and upload them to your Ramp transactions. Set up your Gmail and Ramp connectors in Grok Bot and the bot will run daily. Boom!

tips.author: mattkim1
tips.title: Say yes before it submits
tips.excerpt: Public template if you want the same Grok Bot Fantasy Football GM setup I run. Start/sit, waivers, trades, injury flags in your scoring. It can submit after you say yes.

tips.author: teeRex247
tips.title: Paste the PR, get a brief
tips.excerpt: Good loop. The human review step goes a lot faster with a brief up front: what changed vs the ticket, risky spots with file and line, and what to test by hand.
